mapper.select: select a.id, a.user_id userId, a.award_name awardName, a.level, a.award_time awardTime, a.status, a.award_org awardOrg, a.certificate_path certificatePath, a.certificate_name certificateName, a.certificate_size certificateSize, a.audit_user_id auditUserId, a.audit_time auditTime, a.audit_remark auditRemark, a.create_time createTime, a.update_time updateTime, a.delete_flag deleteFlag, u.real_name userName, u.employee_id employeeId, u.phone phone, u.department department, u.email email from award a left join users u on a.user_id = u.id where a.delete_flag = 0 and a.user_id = #{userId} and a.status = #{status} order by a.create_time desc
